comment: Each modulation trimmer is a crossfade, not an attenuator: lerp_at at AffineTransform.cpp:161 mixes the knob against the jack voltage, so a trimmer at the far right discards its knob altogether. The knob values are multiplied by five before the crossfade and the result divided by five afterwards for scale, skew and rotation, which is why 5V at a jack means a factor of one, or a whole turn for rotation. The skew at lines 141-142 updates x first and then uses the new x when working out y, so the vertical skew compounds with the horizontal one. The three output jacks run X, Y and then the two-channel one across the panel, which is not their index order: the two-channel output is index 0 and sits on the right.
